definitions.explanation: A formal noun expressing gratitude for another's thoughtfulness or support. Almost always appears with the honorific prefix ご and is restricted to business correspondence and formal speeches.

examples.japanese: ご{高配|こうはい}を{賜|たまわ}る。
{平素|へいそ}は{格別|かくべつ}のご{高配|こうはい}を{賜|たまわ}り、{誠|まこと}にありがとうございます。
examples.english: We sincerely thank you for your special patronage as always.

examples.japanese: {今後|こんご}とも{変|か}わらぬご{高配|こうはい}のほど、よろしくお{願|ねが}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: We humbly ask for your continued patronage going forward.

notes:
A set formal noun used almost exclusively in written business correspondence and ceremonial speeches. Always takes the honorific ご and is paired with verbs of receiving such as {賜|たまわ}る or いただく.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{高配|こうはい}を{賜|たまわ}る: to receive your kind consideration
- {格別|かくべつ}のご{高配|こうはい}: your exceptional patronage
- {変|か}わらぬご{高配|こうはい}: your unchanging patronage
- ご{高配|こうはい}のほど: (a softener closing the phrase)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ご{愛顧|あいこ}: your patronage — used by businesses thanking customers
- ご{厚情|こうじょう}: your warm-hearted favor — slightly warmer in tone, used for personal gratitude
- お{引|ひ}き{立|た}て: your support — slightly less stiff but similarly formal
